name: Royal Victoria Hospital, Netley, The
title: Royal Victoria Hospital, Netley, The
---

This was a military hospital founded in 1856. Its first governor was CMY’s friend Colonel [Richard Wilbraham](/person/1515). It survived until 1978 and is now a country park.

See http://www3.hants.gov.uk/hampshire-countryside/rvcp/history-rvcp.htm
and Anne Summers, \'Ministering angels\'.
